method: Read current source, original requirements and archived v075 JSON; inspect the two existing final-d pressure PNGs with view_image. No browser, game, test or build was run. Only this plan JSON and its Markdown companion are written; prior evidence is unchanged.

requirements.exactText: - `AC-M14-06`：常驻 HUD 使用克制的生物科技风格，玩家、病毒、器官危机和抗体效果层级清楚；在不同器官配色下均有足够文字/形状对比，面板不成为主要光污染源。
- `AC-M14-07`：正式战斗时使用高密度病毒、粒子、前景遮挡场景验证目标/危险/弱点可读；同时提供低特效档并保证危险判定提示不消失。
- `AC-M16-04`：在项目实际目标设备上进行 10 分钟压力运行，平均帧率目标 ≥50、帧时间 p95 ≤33ms（可随设备记录与性能预算共同调整），无持续内存增长/无控制台致命错误。
12. `RUN-12` 风格与战斗可读性：同场景病毒三分支形态对照→心脏搏动及肺部气流对照→密集混战/低特效→玩家、危险、弱点和当前器官均能辨认。
| `VIS-07` | G1–G2 | 危险、弱点、扫描与治疗至少两种非颜色信号；高光和粒子不过度盖住关键角色/预警 | 常规与密集战斗截图 |
| `VIS-10` | G4 | 实时 HUD 在 1366×768 与 1920×1080 下不遮挡关键可射击区域，缩放后布局/提示可读 | 多分辨率截图 |
| `VIS-11` | G4 | 普通/低特效模式下的伤害与碰撞判定一致，低特效仍显示所有致命警示；压力战斗满足 M16 帧率预算 | 同 seed 对比 + 帧率报告 |

unit.scope: All current unit files except the unchanged full-system 1000-formal-session batch. Evolution director seed audit is a separate unit test, not 1000 new browser games.

browser.scope: 26 targeted allocations: 2 browsers × real growth/upgrade/hits, actual marked-cell full-run/retry, 3 HUD viewport samples, and 8 training/input/lifecycle cases. Resize/DPR and synthetic focus retain their original scope; not OS focus, actual browser zoom, human testing or performance.

shortPerformance.scope: 120 active seconds, about half per real quality UI setting; source-b and retained source keep real open production, 24 actors with three real cells captured in both modes, accepted cell hits, frame budget and natural heap/DOM samples. Targeted regression; not a ten-minute acceptance run. Memory, native-focus/zoom and human acceptance remain separate.

scope: Technical rendering comparison derived from a read-only snapshot; no main.ts, GameSession.step(), live release state writes, or game-time advancement.
Complete JSON equality plus SHA-256 of full state, HP, damage records, and collision geometry are checked at render-call boundaries.
Not a same-input gameplay replay, browser victory, ten-minute performance measurement, visual readability acceptance, or human playtest.
This verifies rendering does not change gameplay state. Shared danger/collision geometry remains covered separately by existing coreVisuals and geometry unit tests.
Images are Canvas2D backing stores only, with no HUD. Visual differences between normal/low effects are permitted.

existingVisualReview.scope: 6 opening tissue/patrol HUD samples at3 sizes×2 browsers, plus2 crystal-shell/immune support samples. All listed images have core locked, no criticalSince and no organAlarm; these are real finite normal-scene observations, not dense core acceptance.

newReadOnlyCensus.scope: References may repeat the same run and nested state; not independent gameplay runs. Only these explicitly scanned directories are claimed.

pressurePngInspection.method: Existing unedited native browser PNGs loaded through view_image; no new capture or pixel modification.
observations: Player, research/terminal labels, squad title and organism vital rail can be found; both frames contain a compact cluster of circle/scan/immune effects around the right-hand tissue/enemy group.
Both images show separate elite/squad/tissue captions but do not show an active mother-core attack or a true core recovery weakness.

Many ordinary bodies overlap almost exactly; a small number of visually separated silhouettes is not equivalent to the number of live centers. Dense geometry exists, but all-threat clarity and attribution are not established by the count.
Foreground area projects along the far right/HUD edge; this is not sufficient evidence that foreground actually overlaps and challenges the central dangerous/weak point while remaining readable.
pressurePngInspection.limits: The2 states are different live ticks. Center18/19 and world24 are descriptive counts only; neither establishes readability or a new numeric density threshold.

purpose: VIS-07 danger/weakness semantics in the actual production composition
minimumRecommendedCollection.route: One or, if trait pairs require it, two ordinary formal routes whose actually logged core trait pairs collectively cover CARAPACE/FISSION/MIMIC. Capture all currently distinct core mechanisms when naturally eligible, plus actual recovery/interrupt exposure. Two routes is an efficient proposal, not a new design gate.
minimumRecommendedCollection.legalInputs: Use existing public-input progression helpers as navigation only; mouse/keyboard/UI choices and legitimate movement/attack/repair/Q/E advance the live game. Read-only snapshots/events/diagnostics may select a capture. Never assign live HP/phase/traits/clock/attack/position.
minimumRecommendedCollection.captureWindows: Bracket each unedited active-game native screenshot with complete read-only before/after states. Require the accepted attack ID/kind/organ/resolveAt to survive both brackets to attribute a windup screenshot; for exposure require same core ID and exposedUntil beyond both elapsed values. A transition screenshot may be retained honestly but does not establish a missing active phase.
minimumRecommendedCollection.outputs: Input history/accepted event IDs, full source snapshot+SHA, unedited PNG+SHA, build/source provenance and short actual image review. New captures go to a new completion-v075 attempt directory; old artifacts remain unchanged.
minimumRecommendedCollection.efficiency: Do not require a new complete victory after a usable warning was captured. Switch real quality settings through UI, or derive exact normal/low pure drawings from the saved snapshot; distinguish those methods.

purpose: VIS-07 post-effects do not cover essential actors/warnings
minimumRecommendedCollection.route: During the same formal routes where possible, use legitimate movement near a real foreground/raised fold and retain enough naturally active enemies/effects to challenge the visible play area. Capture ordinary/core danger or real weakness in representative normal and low contexts; record which geometry actually overlaps foreground/HUD.
minimumRecommendedCollection.acceptance: Actual images must support finding player, dangerous extent/direction/time, true weak point and organ. Record body overlap and failure honestly. Original text specifies no enemy-count minimum, no worst-case infinity and no need for every threat×organ×viewport×quality Cartesian product.
minimumRecommendedCollection.reuse: Current final-d pressure images can be cited for real clustered ordinary pressure and accepted cell activity. They do not close missing core/foreground/weakpoint combinations; existing same-tick fixture can quantify preservation, not replace native HUD pictures.

purpose: tighten all-warning semantic low parity without replaying the entire game
minimumRecommendedCollection.inputs: Use the6 selected v075 sources listed above, plus the newly collected actual core sources. Feed unchanged full states only to an isolated drawing entry importing Renderer, not main/GameSession.step.
minimumRecommendedCollection.checks: Independent normal/low Renderer, symmetric caches/fonts, identical tick/elapsed/aim, full JSON/SHA+HP/damage/collision fingerprints, actual serialized geometry/time/guards and essential shapes. Existing coverage can be cited; add only missing source branches. Reduced decorative particles are expected.
minimumRecommendedCollection.limits: These are derived real-snapshot drawings and may omit main DOM HUD. Label them as such; not formal live screenshots, damage execution, player observation or performance. Do not use pixel-count difference as readability.

purpose: AC-M14-06/VIS-10 hierarchy when warning text is actually critical
VIS-11 DOM lethal warning not silently omitted
minimumRecommendedCollection.route: Obtain actual infection critical and/or organ alarm states via bounded normal inputs, using existing lifecycle routes where possible; inspect actual long warning text and decisive area. Do not promote the normal explanatory line as equivalent.
minimumRecommendedCollection.efficiency: Share screenshots/records with the broader HUD/native environment workstream; do not repeat all ordinary scene sampling or require both browsers for every danger variant unless a real difference warrants it.

technicalVisualHumanSeparation.technicalCompleteness: Use frozen current source+qualified existing units, no gameplay use of quality flags, real-snapshot state invariance and per-warning draw geometry/guards to establish presentation cannot change accepted damage/collision. New code changes or uncovered branches warrant targeted regression; do not rerun broad tests merely to collect screenshots.
technicalVisualHumanSeparation.actualImageInspection: A reviewer must inspect unedited final-size actual images and say what can/cannot be distinguished; rectangles, FPS, actor counts, labels and pixel differences alone are insufficient. One image may cover several original clauses; a series may show windup and recovery at different natural times.
technicalVisualHumanSeparation.humanObservation: Five new-player blind observations remain0/5 and belong to AC-M16-05/VIS-12 and related first-play clauses. Do not invent comprehension/fun/replay rates. Do not make5-player testing a new literal prerequisite for the technical screenshot subclauses of VIS-07/11.
technicalVisualHumanSeparation.performance: The qualified v075120s sample supports a targeted frame-budget regression. AC-M16-04 explicitly asks a target-device10-minute run and no sustained growth; that outstanding workstream remains separate. No new requirement for10minutes per warning, per trait, all hardware, or infinite zero growth is introduced.

notNewGates: No fixed dense enemy count or mandated screenshot count in the cited original rows.
No requirement that every core attack/weakness be simultaneously active; the controller has one attack and disjoint recovery timing.
No all-type×organ×resolution×quality×browser exhaustive matrix. Cover actual distinct essential branches technically and representative native hard scenes visually.
No need to replay completed broad regression/full victories for a presentation-only missing image.
No original requirement that exact same live tick be obtained by UI quality switching; use source-captured independent drawing pairs honestly when exact-state comparison is useful.
Do not substitute viewport/DPR/CSS scaling or synthetic blur for the separate real browser zoom/native-focus clauses.
completionRule: Keep the original rows partial until the relevant missing technical/real-image evidence is actually obtained and reviewed. This plan does not itself pass an acceptance row, declare fun/incubation value, or close user playtesting.
